versions.changelog:
- Initial release of qiyue-ziwei-drawer.
- Enables drawing Zi Wei Dou Shu charts by inputting birth date, time, and gender.
- Outputs Five Elements class and main stars for all twelve palaces, as provided by QiyueAstro.
- No API key or login required; free and stateless access.
- Always displays full palace data with no interpretation or judgement remarks.
